pitch.turf: vibrant green grassy turf with realistic blade texture
pitch.lines: crisp white painted boundary lines, center line, and penalty box
pitch.flags: four corner flagposts (1.5m high, non-pointed) featuring blue and white checkered flags printed with the blue jaguar head emblem
pitch.boundary: sandy runoff area alongside the touchline of the pitch

kits.player_home: dark blue and white striped jersey with an icon blue jaguar head emblem on the chest, dark blue shorts with a single white stripe, dark blue socks, black cleated shoes
kits.player_away: white jersey with an icon red gazelle head emblem on the chest, white shorts with a single red stripe, red socks, black cleated shoes
kits.goalkeeper_home: black and white striped jersey with an icon blue jaguar head emblem on the chest, black shorts, black socks, black cleated shoes, black oversized gloves
kits.goalkeeper_away: solid light blue jersey with an icon red gazelle head emblem on the chest, light red shorts, red socks, black cleated shoes, white oversized gloves
kits.referee: yellow and white striped jersey with an icon black shield mblem on the chest, yellow shorts with a single white stripe, yellow socks, black cleated shoes
